hero-description.value: A diversified general trading company operating across multiple commodity sectors.

section-1-body-1.value: AL Farhan General Trading (AFGT) is a diversified trading company headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. AFGT operates across multiple commodity sectors with a focus on institutional partnerships.

section-1-body-2.value: The company serves markets across the Middle East, Africa, Asia Pacific, and Europe through a network of strategic partnerships and operational facilities.

section-2-body-1.value: AFGT operates in 25 countries with a presence spanning four continents. The company manages commodity flows across sugar, wheat, oils, urea, and maritime transport sectors.

section-2-body-2.value: Through direct trading relationships and long-term supply agreements, AFGT connects producers and consumers across global markets.
